overview_description.description:
An e-commerce business can enhance its customer relationships with the help of Awtomic, a subscription management software. The software assists e-commerce brands in building brand loyalty, increasing life time value, and building sustainable businesses with the power of trustworthy subscriptions. 
The company has received backing from investment funds such as Y Combinator and Index Ventures as well as senior leadership from companies like Eventbrite, Redfin, and Privy.

about_short_description.short_description: Awtomic is a subscription management software that enables e-commerce businesses to enhance their customer relationships.

product.name: Subscription Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based software for e-commerce businesses to create, manage, and customize subscription products and membership services.

product.name: Build-a-Box Feature
product.description: A tool that allows customers to create personalized product bundles with fixed or dynamic pricing and configurable box sizes.

product.name: Awtomic Moments
product.description: A lifecycle marketing tool that enables personalized retention experiences through tailored rewards and customer engagement.

product.name: Subscription Add-ons and Upsells
product.description: A feature that promotes relevant one-time or subscription add-on products to increase average order value.

product.name: Analytics Dashboard
product.description: An analytics tool providing data and insights on subscription performance, customer retention, and lifetime value.

product.name: Migration and Onboarding Services
product.description: Services to assist merchants in migrating subscription data and setting up the Awtomic platform with support and customization.
